data.one_liner: A statistical multi-runtime benchmarking framework for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A benchmarking framework that runs tests across VM JIT, Native AOT, WebAssembly, and JavaScript with adaptive warmup, dead code elimination barriers, and Fieller confidence intervals.
use_when: You need to measure and compare performance of Dart or Flutter code across multiple runtimes.
You require statistically rigorous benchmarks with variance decomposition and equivalence testing.
avoid_when: You are looking for UI widget testing or integration testing tools.
You need standard unit testing assertions rather than performance benchmarking.
strengths: Supports multi-runtime orchestration (JIT, AOT, Wasm, JS).
Provides statistical rigor with Fieller confidence intervals and adaptive warmup.
Includes multi-process benchmark capabilities to isolate OS-level variance.
weaknesses: Not documented for general app testing or widget assertions.
Requires careful configuration to minimize OS noise for sub-3% speedups.
data.setup_notes: Add bench_press to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml.
